identityTradability.exchangeName: Ericsson - American Depositary Shares each representing 1 underlying Class B share

thesisQuality.basis: Strong installed mobile-network relevance, Q2 margin resilience and multi-year portfolio investment support a strong band, while scaled AI-radio economics remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 adjusted gross margin 48.4%, adjusted EBITA margin 13.1%, net cash SEK 59.839b and positive H1 FCF support strength; Q2 organic sales -1% and lower Q2 FCF cap the score.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 21 market snapshot shows $10.25 ADR, ~$33.48b market cap and 13.17 trailing P/E: plausible headroom but not enough evidence for a strong valuation band.

catalystScore.basis: Next quarterly earnings are identified for Oct. 15, while ongoing AI-connectivity portfolio commercialization and pricing actions are source-supported but execution-dependent.

governancePower.basis: Disciplined restructuring, SEK 8.2b Q2 capital returns and a strong net-cash position support adequate-to-strong capital allocation; exceptional long-duration stewardship is not established.

alignment2036.basis: Mobile connectivity, 5G/AI-enabled networks and physical-world connectivity are foundational infrastructure across multiple long-duration digital futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Networks, Cloud Software and Services, Enterprise and other activities provide multiple demand channels, with Q2 organic growth in three of four market areas.

bottleneckControl.basis: Radio/network technology, qualification and installed carrier relationships create meaningful switching friction, but competing vendors and architectures prevent an exceptional bottleneck claim.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Geographic breadth, multiple network/software segments and strong net cash support resilience; carrier capex cycles, FX and input inflation remain material sensitivities.

substitutionResilience.basis: Technology leadership and qualification barriers support moderate-to-strong resilience, but competing RAN architectures/vendors remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Q1 explicitly cites multi-year investment in a resilient diversified supply chain and continued delivery through geopolitical uncertainty; semiconductor/input-cost pressure remains.

pricingPower.basis: 48.4% adjusted gross margin and disclosed pricing actions to offset component inflation support pricing ability, though durability through future carrier cycles is not fully proven.

riskEvidence.basis: Material but manageable risks include carrier capex cyclicality, FX, component inflation, substitution by competing RAN vendors and uncertain monetization of AI-native radio capability.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC/issuer quarterly evidence plus FY2025 primary reporting and an independent current valuation snapshot cover all score components; customer-level AI economics and detailed supplier concentration remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: Ericsson combines carrier-grade network infrastructure, improving operating discipline, strong net cash and long-duration connectivity/AI infrastructure relevance; upside depends on translating technology leadership into durable operator economics.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Carrier spending cyclicality, vendor substitution, FX/input inflation and unproven incremental economics from newer AI-native network products can limit growth and value capture.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 earnings scheduled for October 15, 2026, with focus on organic sales, Networks margins, pricing actions and cash conversion.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the methodology-weighted sum of the 12 source-addressed component assessments; risk and confidence are separately reported gates and are not silently reweighted here.
